# JR Strength & Fitness

> JR Romero, CSCS (full name JR Prieto-Romero), is a strength and conditioning coach in Corvallis, Oregon: Director of Personal Training at Timberhill Athletic Club and Director of Performance at G3 Sports & Fitness. Founder of four coaching products. He coaches in person in Corvallis and online, and builds tools for coaches and athletes.

- Credentials: Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist (CSCS); B.S. in Exercise & Sport Science, Oregon State University; roughly 20,000 hours of coaching.
- Coaching standard: IAOE (Inadequate, Adequate, Optimal, Enhanced). Match the intervention to the person; adequate is a legitimate target.
- Contact: jr@jrstrengthandfitness.com

## Train with JR

- [Train with JR](https://www.jrstrengthandfitness.com/train): in-person personal training in Corvallis at Timberhill Athletic Club or G3 Sports & Fitness. Every client starts with a free 30-minute consult; no membership needed.
- Who JR trains in person: people rebuilding strength after an injury, adults 50 and up, endurance athletes, high school and college athletes (at G3), and first-time lifters.
- Leave a review: https://www.jrstrengthandfitness.com/review (Google reviews of the gyms: https://www.jrstrengthandfitness.com/review/timberhill and https://www.jrstrengthandfitness.com/review/g3).
- [Book a free consult](https://www.jrstrengthandfitness.com/consult): choose Timberhill (health, fitness, longevity) or G3 (youth development, adult performance, tactical and teams).
- [Online coaching](https://www.jrstrengthandfitness.com/online-training): individualized training and nutrition. Essentials $199/month, Core $249/month, Premium $319/month; 3- and 6-month terms lower the rate.
- [Apply for online coaching](https://www.jrstrengthandfitness.com/apply): JR replies within 2 business days; if it's a fit, a short call, then the coaching app invite.

## Projects

- [The Trainer’s Coach Vault](https://www.jrstrengthandfitness.com/projects/vault): Consultation systems, programming frameworks and client-management tools built from real coaching practice.
- [Built For Her™](https://www.jrstrengthandfitness.com/projects/built-for-her): A coach-built training app for women: structured programs, set-by-set logging, nutrition targets and progress tracking.
- [TRAINCND](https://www.jrstrengthandfitness.com/projects/traincnd): One platform to run a coaching business, from the first invitation to the season’s last session.
- [The Credential Standard](https://www.jrstrengthandfitness.com/projects/credential-standard): Which fitness credentials are accredited, what they require and what renewal takes, with every fact cited to its source.

### Personal Trainer Exam Prep (part of The Trainer's Coach Vault)

- [Personal Trainer Exam Prep](https://www.jrstrengthandfitness.com/exam-prep): lists both exam-prep products.
- [NASM-CPT Exam Prep](https://www.jrstrengthandfitness.com/projects/vault/exam-prep): independent practice for the NASM-CPT exam. 1,322 original practice questions written against NASM's public exam blueprint, a 60-question diagnostic, 120-question timed mocks, 150 concept cards and an AI study tutor (up to 15 questions a day; its answers can be wrong). $79 one-time for 180 days, no auto-renewal, or $39/month or $299/year bundled with the Vault. Sold at https://vault.jrstrengthandfitness.com/pricing#exam-prep. No pass guarantee; Practice Readiness is a study signal, not a score or prediction.
- This independent exam-preparation product is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the National Academy of Sports Medicine (NASM). NASM and NASM-CPT are used only to identify the certification exam this product is designed to help users prepare for.
- [ACE-CPT Exam Prep](https://www.jrstrengthandfitness.com/projects/vault/ace-cpt-exam-prep): independent practice for the ACE Certified Personal Trainer exam. 1,300 original practice questions written against ACE's public exam content outline, a 75-question diagnostic, a 150-question timed practice mock, 150 concept cards and an AI study tutor (up to 15 questions a day; its answers can be wrong). $79 one-time for 180 days, no auto-renewal, or $39/month or $299/year bundled with the Vault. Sold at https://vault.jrstrengthandfitness.com/pricing#ace-cpt-exam-prep. No pass guarantee; Practice Readiness is a study signal, not a score or prediction.
- This independent exam-preparation product is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the American Council on Exercise (ACE). ACE and ACE Certified Personal Trainer are used only to identify the certification exam this product is designed to help users prepare for.

## Notes from the Floor (articles)

- [What to Look for in a Personal Trainer in Corvallis, Oregon](https://www.jrstrengthandfitness.com/notes/what-to-look-for-personal-trainer-corvallis): Looking for a personal trainer in Corvallis, Oregon? JR Romero, CSCS explains how he matches clients with coaches, builds training systems and defines progress.
- [Why Your Training Program Stops Working—and What to Fix First](https://www.jrstrengthandfitness.com/notes/why-your-training-program-stops-working): Training progress stalled? Coach JR explains how to check goals, consistency, recovery, and progression before changing your strength program.
- [5 Questions To Ask During A Personal Training Consultation](https://www.jrstrengthandfitness.com/notes/5-questions-to-ask-during-a-personal-training-consultation): For personal trainers, the initial consultation is the first time you meet a potential client, and likely the only chance you'll have to sign them. Here are the five questions I use to run it.
- [Should Men and Women Train Differently?](https://www.jrstrengthandfitness.com/notes/should-men-and-women-train-differently): There are biological differences between men and women in body composition, fat distribution, muscle fiber and hormones, yet exercise prescription is mostly the same. What do the differences mean for training?
- [What Happens When You Combine Strength and Endurance Training?](https://www.jrstrengthandfitness.com/notes/what-happens-when-you-combine-strength-and-endurance-training): Do you still get the benefits of both, or is one prioritized over the other? A review of the research on concurrent strength and endurance training, and how to apply it to your goal.
- [Is Constantly Varied Exercise Worthwhile?](https://www.jrstrengthandfitness.com/notes/is-constantly-varied-exercise-worthwhile): Muscle confusion, CrossFit and P90x made exercise variation a hot topic. A look at the research on constantly varied versus fixed exercise selection, and how to program structured variation.
- [How Quickly You Lose Strength Gains](https://www.jrstrengthandfitness.com/notes/how-quickly-you-lose-strength-gains): Injured, traveling or stuck without a gym? What the research says about how fast strength and muscle actually decline when you stop training, and how fast they come back.

## FAQ

### How do I start personal training with JR in Corvallis?
Book a free 30-minute consult at Timberhill Athletic Club or G3 Sports & Fitness. We cover your goals, training history, limitations, barriers and preferences, then I match you with the right coach, facility and program. Sometimes that coach isn’t me.

### Do I need a gym membership to book a consult?
No. You don’t need to be a member of Timberhill or G3 to book a free consult.

### Should I train at Timberhill Athletic Club or G3 Sports & Fitness?
Timberhill is built around health, general fitness and longevity for adults at every starting point. G3 focuses on youth athletic development, adult human performance, and tactical, team and organization training. Not sure? Pick either one; one consult covers both.

### Can I train with JR if I don’t live in Corvallis?
Yes. Online coaching gives you individualized training and nutrition through the coaching app, with check-ins and adjustments. It starts with an application: I reply within 2 business days, and if it’s a fit we do a short call before you get your app invite.

### How much does online coaching cost?
Essentials is $199 a month, Core is $249 a month and Premium is $319 a month. Three- and six-month terms lower the monthly rate. Every package includes both training and nutrition coaching.

### Do you train beginners?
Yes. Plenty of my clients had never worked with a trainer. We start with technique and a plan you can follow on your own schedule.

### Can you help me get strong again after an injury?
Yes. Once rehab is done, I build a plan around the injury that rebuilds strength and confidence, progressed as you’re ready.

### Do you train high school and college athletes?
Yes, at G3 Sports & Fitness: strength, speed and conditioning for athletes heading into college sport. Athletes I’ve coached have gone on to play at the University of Oregon, the University of Nevada, George Fox, Houston Christian, Saint Anselm and Eastern Illinois.

### Where are the sessions?
In person at Timberhill Athletic Club, 2855 NW 29th St, or G3 Sports & Fitness, 5520 NW Highway 99W, both in Corvallis. Online coaching works anywhere.

### Who is JR Romero?
JR Romero, CSCS, is Director of Personal Training at Timberhill Athletic Club and Director of Performance at G3 Sports & Fitness in Corvallis, Oregon. He earned his degree in Exercise & Sport Science at Oregon State and has roughly 20,000 hours of coaching on the floor.
